question: Find the final QX21 overlay. Bytes +8..+39 are the scratch SHA-256, read scratch length u16le at +40 and HCFG resource length u32le at +44; the HCFG resource starts at +56, and scratch follows it. Verify exact end bounds and scratch SHA-256. Locate the unique CRC32-valid HCFG record: bytes 0..3 are ASCII HCFG, byte 4 is version, byte 5 is the XOR key.
oracle_args: QX21 m scratch_sha256:8:32 scratch_length:40:u16le hcfg_resource_length:44:u32le hcfg_resource:56:hcfg_resource_length scratch:after:scratch_length
oracle_cmd: bash tests/data/binary_fixtures/layoutq_oracle.sh layoutq_permuted_qx21.bin "$(jq -r .oracle_args layoutq_permuted_qx21.json)"  (grep -obaF / od / dd|sha256sum / stat)
